results.caseNameFull: UNITED STATES, Petitioner v. Victor J. STITT, II. United States, Petitioner v. Jason Daniel Sims.
results.court: Supreme Court of the United States

opinions.snippet:
Justice BREYER delivered the opinion of the Court.
 

  The Armed Career Criminal Act requires a federal sentencing judge to impose upon certain persons convicted of unlawfully possessing a firearm a 15-year minimum prison term. The judge is to impose that special sentence if the offender also has three prior convictions for certain violent or drug-related crimes.
